notes: x86-64 Linux, NASM syntax, no libc: only the write and exit syscalls.
SSE2 scalar doubles (cvtsi2sd, mulsd, divsd, addsd, subsd, ucomisd): one rounded operation per instruction, in the spec's order.
in_set answers in the carry flag, and adc shifts that bit straight into the byte being packed.
Own 64 KiB output buffer, flushed with a retry loop for partial writes; ~8 KiB static binary.
